sources.games: 713 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats, support position: under 2.5 last hits a minute), win 49.5%. Thin sample note: none of the groups under 20 games is used; the Ghost Scepter rule rests on 57 games of Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar lineups. rules.name: Ghost Scepter
rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Ghost Scepter (1500 gold): 4 s ghost form, immune to physical damage but unable to attack and more vulnerable to magic damage, 22 s cooldown. Ghost Scepter is not in the usual build (under 25% of the won games); high-rank Shadow Shamans against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar buy it in 19% of 57 games against them (9% otherwise), won 64% against 57%. Shackles is channeled, so the 4 s of ghost form do not stop the cast.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 99% (4), magic_wand 72% (5), ring_of_basilius 74% (8), tranquil_boots 24% (9), arcane_boots 72% (11), blink 97% (19), aghanims_shard 32% (25), aether_lens 53% (26), ogre_axe 21% (29), glimmer_cape 24% (29), staff_of_wizardry 22% (29). Reviewed: dropped Ring of Basilius, Tranquil Boots (900 gold), Ogre Axe and Staff of Wizardry (parts). Glimmer Cape added last from STRATZ pos5 (27 min, 38% of 8439 games, won 55%): in the league games it is 24% of the won games (29 min). STRATZ pos5 order: Blink Dagger 19, Aether Lens 26 (41%), Glimmer Cape 27; pos4: Blink Dagger 18 (100%).
